position.en: We're looking to fill the position of sales assistant by next month.
position.zh: 我们希望在下个月前招到销售助理这个职位的人选。

position.en: From this position on the hill, you can see the whole town.
position.zh: 从山上这个位置,你能看到整个小镇。

applicant.en: Each applicant will be asked to give a short talk at the interview.
applicant.zh: 每位申请人都要在面试时做一个简短的发言。

application-form.en: Please fill in the application form and return it by Friday.
application-form.zh: 请填写申请表,并在周五前交回。

cv.en: Please send your CV and a covering letter by the end of this week.
cv.zh: 请在本周末前发送你的简历和求职信。

resume-cv.en: Keep your résumé to one page when you apply for jobs in America.
resume-cv.zh: 在美国求职时,简历要控制在一页以内。

cover-letter.en: A good cover letter explains why you want to work for that company.
cover-letter.zh: 一封好的求职信要说明你为什么想在那家公司工作。

interview.en: I've got an interview for a job at the hospital on Monday.
interview.zh: 我周一要去医院面试一份工作。

interview.en: The manager will interview all five candidates over the next two days.
interview.zh: 经理将在接下来两天面试全部五位候选人。

candidate.en: The best candidate for this job will have experience of working with children.
candidate.zh: 这份工作的最佳人选应有与儿童打交道的经验。

qualification.en: You don't need any special qualifications to work in our shop.
qualification.zh: 在我们店工作不需要任何特殊的资格。

certificate.en: You'll receive a certificate when you complete the first aid course.
certificate.zh: 完成急救课程后,你将获得一份证书。

diploma.en: She has a diploma in hotel management from a college in Dublin.
diploma.zh: 她持有都柏林一所学院颁发的酒店管理文凭。

experience.en: Do you have any experience of working in a restaurant?
experience.zh: 你有在餐厅工作的经验吗?

internship.en: I did a three-month internship at a newspaper during the summer.
internship.zh: 暑假期间我在一家报社实习了三个月。

trainee.en: As a trainee, you'll spend your first month working with an experienced chef.
trainee.zh: 作为实习生,你第一个月将跟着一位经验丰富的厨师工作。

apprentice.en: He started as an apprentice in a garage when he was sixteen.
apprentice.zh: 他十六岁时在一家修车厂当学徒。

part-time.en: I have a part-time job in a café at weekends.
part-time.zh: 我周末在一家咖啡馆做兼职。

full-time.en: The company is offering her a full-time job after she graduates.
full-time.zh: 公司打算在她毕业后给她一份全职工作。

shift.en: I'm working the early shift tomorrow, so I have to get up at five.
shift.zh: 我明天上早班,所以五点就得起床。

overtime.en: Staff are paid extra for any overtime they do at weekends.
overtime.zh: 员工周末加班可获得额外报酬。

flexible-hours.en: Flexible hours let me start late on the days I have classes.
flexible-hours.zh: 弹性工作时间让我在有课的日子可以晚点上班。

salary.en: The starting salary for this job is about £28,000 a year.
salary.zh: 这份工作的起薪大约是每年 28000 英镑。

wage.en: The hourly wage at the supermarket is higher than at the café.
wage.zh: 超市的时薪比咖啡馆高。

bonus.en: All staff receive a bonus at the end of a good year.
bonus.zh: 业绩好的年份,全体员工年底都会拿到奖金。

pension.en: The company pays part of your salary into a pension every month.
pension.zh: 公司每月把你工资的一部分存入养老金。

perk.en: One of the perks of the job is free lunch in the canteen.
perk.zh: 这份工作的福利之一是在食堂免费吃午饭。

annual-leave.en: Staff get twenty-five days of annual leave plus public holidays.
annual-leave.zh: 员工除公共假期外还有二十五天年假。

sick-leave.en: You should call your manager before nine if you need sick leave.
sick-leave.zh: 如果需要请病假,应在九点前打电话给经理。

maternity-leave.en: Our company gives six months of maternity leave on full pay.
maternity-leave.zh: 我们公司提供六个月全薪产假。

probation.en: All new staff are on probation for their first three months.
probation.zh: 所有新员工前三个月都处于试用期。

contract.en: Read your contract carefully before you agree to start work.
contract.zh: 同意开始工作之前,请仔细阅读你的合同。

employer.en: My employer pays for me to attend a language course every year.
employer.zh: 我的雇主每年出钱让我上语言课程。

employee.en: Each employee gets a free parking space behind the office.
employee.zh: 每位雇员都有一个办公室后面的免费停车位。

colleague.en: My colleagues organised a small party when I left the company.
colleague.zh: 我离开公司时,同事们办了一个小型聚会。

supervisor.en: You should tell your supervisor in advance if you need a day off.
supervisor.zh: 如果需要请假,你应该提前告诉主管。

manager.en: The restaurant manager will show you around on your first day.
manager.zh: 第一天餐厅经理会带你四处看看。

personnel.en: Please hand your forms in to personnel on the second floor.
personnel.zh: 请把表格交到三楼的人事部。

human-resources.en: Contact human resources if you have any questions about your pay.
human-resources.zh: 如果对工资有疑问,请联系人力资源部。

department.en: She works in the sales department of a large furniture company.
department.zh: 她在一家大型家具公司的销售部工作。

headquarters.en: The company's headquarters are in Leeds, but it has offices across Europe.
headquarters.zh: 公司总部在利兹,但在欧洲各地都设有办事处。

promotion.en: He got a promotion after only two years with the company.
promotion.zh: 他进公司才两年就升职了。

promotion.en: The shop is running a special promotion on sports shoes this week.
promotion.zh: 这家店本周正在做运动鞋的特别促销。

resign.en: She decided to resign because the journey to work was too long.
resign.zh: 她决定辞职,因为上班路程太远。

retire.en: My father hopes to retire at sixty and move to the coast.
retire.zh: 我父亲希望六十岁退休,然后搬到海边。

volunteer.en: We need a volunteer to help serve drinks at the charity event.
volunteer.zh: 我们需要一名志愿者在慈善活动上帮忙倒饮料。

volunteer.en: I volunteered to clean the beach with a local group last weekend.
volunteer.zh: 上周末,我主动和当地一个团体去清理了海滩。

recruit.en: The museum is hoping to recruit ten volunteers for the summer.
recruit.zh: 博物馆希望为暑期招募十名志愿者。

award.en: She won an award for the best young chef in the region.
award.zh: 她获得了该地区最佳青年厨师奖。

award.en: The college will award a prize to the student with the highest marks.
award.zh: 学院将向成绩最高的学生颁发奖品。

commission.en: Our sales staff earn a commission on every car they sell.
commission.zh: 我们的销售人员每卖一辆车都能拿到佣金。

commission.en: The council has decided to commission a new statue for the square.
commission.zh: 市议会决定委托制作一座新雕像放在广场上。

benefit.en: Free health insurance is one of the main benefits of this job.
benefit.zh: 免费医疗保险是这份工作的主要福利之一。

benefit.en: The whole team will benefit from the new training programme.
benefit.zh: 整个团队都将从新的培训计划中受益。

absenteeism.en: Poor working conditions can lead to high levels of absenteeism among staff.
absenteeism.zh: 恶劣的工作条件可能导致员工缺勤率居高不下。

secretary.en: The school secretary can give you a copy of the timetable.
secretary.zh: 学校秘书可以给你一份课程表。

clerk.en: I worked as a clerk in a law firm before I went to college.
clerk.zh: 上大学前,我在一家律师事务所当职员。

night-shift.en: Nurses on the night shift start at eight and finish at seven.
night-shift.zh: 上夜班的护士八点上班,七点下班。

unemployment-benefit.en: You may be able to claim unemployment benefit while you look for work.
unemployment-benefit.zh: 找工作期间,你也许可以申请失业救济金。

letter-of-recommendation.en: My tutor agreed to write me a letter of recommendation for the job.
letter-of-recommendation.zh: 我的导师同意为这份工作给我写一封推荐信。

portfolio.en: Art students must hand in a portfolio of their work by Friday.
portfolio.zh: 艺术专业的学生必须在周五前提交作品集。

portfolio.en: Her investment portfolio includes shares in several large companies.
portfolio.zh: 她的投资组合包括几家大公司的股票。

consultant.en: The firm hired a consultant to advise them on saving energy.
consultant.zh: 公司聘请了一位顾问,就节能问题提供建议。

assistant.en: She started as an assistant in the shop and now runs the business.
assistant.zh: 她从店里的助理做起,现在经营着这家店。

technician.en: A technician will come to fix the printer this afternoon.
technician.zh: 今天下午技术员会来修打印机。

deputy.en: The deputy manager will be in charge while I'm away next week.
deputy.zh: 我下周不在时,由副经理负责。

veteran.en: As a veteran of the hotel trade, he knows what guests really want.
veteran.zh: 作为酒店业的老手,他知道客人真正想要什么。

amateur.en: Our team is made up of amateur players who train after work.
amateur.zh: 我们队由下班后训练的业余球员组成。

amateur.en: Although she's only an amateur, her paintings are sold in local galleries.
amateur.zh: 虽然她只是业余爱好者,但她的画在当地画廊出售。

appraisal.en: You'll have an appraisal with your manager at the end of each year.
appraisal.zh: 每年年底,你都会和经理进行一次工作考核。
